Barbatul anului

Iliana Xander, Laura Nureldin (Translator)

3.82
17,028 ratings1,920 reviews
Rate this book
Este „Bărbatul Anului”… sau monstrul anului?

Când Natalie își vede cea mai bună prietenă plecând din club alături de un străin chipeș, nu își poate imagina că, a doua zi dimineață, aceasta va fi găsită inconștientă într-o stație de autobuz.

Ce s-a întâmplat în noaptea aceea? Până când prietena ei nu se va trezi din comă, adevărul rămâne îngropat în tăcere. Apoi, într-o zi, Natalie îl recunoaște. Este chiar bărbatul din acea seară, zâmbind perfect de pe coperta unei reviste, declarat drept „Bărbatul Anului”.

Privește-l mai atent. Este milionar. Faimos. De neatins. Și totuși, ceva îi spune lui Natalie că sub această imagine impecabilă se ascunde un pericol real.

Hotărâtă să afle adevărul, se angajează ca menajeră în conacul lui. Planul pare simplu: să-i urmărească fiecare mișcare și să adune dovezi. Dar când află că menajera dinaintea ei a dispărut fără urmă, Natalie înțelege că nu mai controlează jocul și s-ar putea să devină următoarea lui victimă.

When I fell in love with Iliana Xander’s debut novel, Love, Mom, earlier this year, I had my fingers crossed that she’d stay on my list of new favorite authors. Well, I’m happy to report that she has definitely cemented herself there with her new heart-stopping stunner, All Eyes on Him. Propulsive, witty, and the definition of the perfect popcorn thriller, it had me absolutely spellbound from the first gripping page until the soul-satisfying conclusion. You see, not only was the plot as twisty as it was clever, but the characters ran the gamut from endearing to despicable. That being said, the storyline was still my favorite part of this unputdownable novel. With one gasp-inducing twist after the other coming out of thin air, the execution was on point, and even included a shocking *mic drop* moment in the middle.

All said and done, it’s clear that Ms. Xander has done it yet again. From the delicious dark secrets to the ominous atmosphere, every step in this book had me won over completely. When I say that, I swear I’m not exaggerating in the slightest. You see, not only did the short, addictive chapters keep me in the dark the entire time I was reading, but the unnamed narrator and plot-shifting twists delivered a revenge plot for the ages that I definitely won’t be forgetting. With creepy stalker vibes and a well-played game of cat-and-mouse, nothing was as it seemed in this slump-busting thriller. Perfect for fans of the great Freida McFadden or anyone who loves fast-paced, action-packed scenes, you need to grab this book now. Just be prepared to read it cover to cover in one single sitting. Rating of 5 stars.

SYNOPSIS:

Natalie’s best friend leaves the dance club with a handsome stranger and is found unconscious at a bus stop the next morning. What happened that night? Only Natalie’s friend knows—except she’s in the hospital, in a coma…

When Natalie sees a handsome man on the cover of a financial magazine, she recognizes the “Man of the Year”—the stranger her friend left the club with.

He is a millionaire. He is famous. He is untouchable. And—Natalie suspects—dangerous. Desperate for answers, she takes a job as a housekeeper at his mansion.

Her plan is simple. Get close to him, watch his every move, gather evidence, and make him pay.

Except something’s not right about the mansion. Strange rules, hostile treatment from the staff, and an eerie feeling that she’s being watched and followed home. And what exactly happened to the previous housekeeper who went missing?

Natalie thought she was setting a trap. But the day she discovers the shocking truth about the “Man of the Year,” she realizes she might have walked straight into his…

Thank you Iliana Xander and Poisoned Pen Press for my complimentary copy. All opinions are my own.

PUB DATE: December 2, 2025

Content warning: abortion, stalking, drugging, alcoholism, kidnapping, violence, mention of: terminal cancer, murder, torture

Jest to mój pierwszy kontakt z książkami autorki. Spodziewałam się thrillera psychologicznego, który jest dość specyficzny, bo większość przerażających rzeczy dzieje się w umysłach bohaterów. Ta książka to powieść wielogatunkowa, łącząca w sobie thriller psychologiczny, thriller kryminalny, obyczajówkę i sensację. W tej książce dzieje się tak dużo, że jak się wpadnie w spiralę wydarzeń, ciężko się oderwać. A zaczęło się niewinnie...

Przyjaciółka Natalie zostaje znaleziona nieprzytomna. Poprzednią noc spędziła w klubie z nowo poznanym mężczyzną. Przypadkiem Natalie zauważa wizerunek mężczyzny na okładce gazety. Okazuje się, że jest milionerem, okrzykniętym "Mężczyzną Roku". Poznając jego tożsamość, Natalie postanawia dowiedzieć się, co zaszło feralnej nocy. Znowu przypadkiem ratuje mężczyznę, który okazuje się być kierowcą milionera. W podziękowaniu dostaje propozycję pracy przy imprezie organizowanej przez milionera. Nikt nie jest tym, za kogo się przedstawia. Chciwość, zemsta, władza — każdego bohatera napędza coś innego. Coś, za co są w stanie zapłacić bardzo dużo, są gotowi na ofiary. Krąg niebezpieczeństw zacieśnia się coraz bardziej.

Historia jest interesująca i wciąga, jednak nie wszystko jest dopracowane. Między precyzyjne wątki zaplątane są niewiarygodne zbiegi okoliczności. Postać Natalie jest nierozsądna, nieodpowiedzialna, zbyt beztrosko podchodzi do zagrożeń.

W powieści działo się dużo. Dla mnie za dużo. Czasem mniej znaczy więcej. Czułam przesyt.

Thank you to NetGalley, the author, and Poisoned Pen Press for this eARC in exchange for my honest review.
Publication Date: December 2, 2025 🗓️

So what’s it about? 👀
When Natalie saw her best friend leaving a club with a handsome stranger, she never could’ve guessed that the next morning her friend would be found unconscious at a bus stop. Now she’s in a coma, and until she wakes up, no one knows what really happened that night.

Desperate for answers, Natalie discovers the man her friend left with is no ordinary stranger — he’s a public figure, recently crowned “Man of the Year.” Wealthy. Famous. Untouchable. Determined to expose him, she takes a job as his housekeeper to dig into his secrets. But when she learns the last housekeeper went missing... she starts to realize she may have just walked into her own trap. 😬

My Thoughts 💭
I devoured this book in less than 24 hours because I had to know where it was going. The premise was solid, the tension was high, and the setup had all the makings of a binge-worthy thriller.

That said… it was chaotic. There were so many moving parts and side characters that it started to feel a little disorganized. I love unpredictable twists and morally gray characters — those are my jam — but here, the cluttered storytelling took away from the suspense that could’ve made this one great.

Final Thoughts 🔎
A fast-paced, twisty thriller with a solid concept and dark intrigue — just not as tightly executed as I hoped. Still, I can absolutely see other readers loving the ride!

Thank you to NetGalley and Poisoned Pen Press for providing a digital copy of this book in exchange for my honest review.

I really wanted to enjoy this book, as Xander’s previous novel, Love, Mom, had a lot of the fun elements I look for in a popcorn thriller. Unfortunately, All Eyes on Him did absolutely nothing for me. I was intrigued at the book’s onset as Natalie became a housekeeper for a mysterious millionaire who may have assaulted her best friend. The premise had so much potential, but, girl. Natalie was quite possibly one of the most annoying main characters I’ve ever read. Her amateur sleuthing constantly got on my nerves, and she seemed to spend most of the book getting in everyone else's way. By her third day on the job, I was already losing interest.

The twists were also less than satisfying. I’m sorry, but white-collar financial crimes don't pack the same punch for me as a serial killer or a more sinister villain. 😆 Swing and a miss!

ALL EYES ON HIM by Iliana Xander
When Natalie’s best friend and roommate, Cara, is found unconscious and slips into a coma, her world flips upside down. Determined to uncover what happened, Natalie starts tracking down the mysterious guy Cara left the club with the night before. What she finds? A dark, twisty psychological thriller that pulls her and the reader, straight into paranoia, doubt, and danger. Who can she trust? Who should she trust? The tension builds beautifully, and the twists had me questioning everything right up until the end.
This was my first read from Iliana Xander, and I was hooked by her writing style, short, addictive chapters and shifting POVs that kept the pace flying. And that ending? Chef’s kiss. Every puzzle piece clicks into place perfectly.
Huge thank you to @poisonedpenpress and @ilianaxander.author for this ARC in exchange for an honest review.

‼️ Book Review
All Eyes On Him - Iliana Xander
ARC - publish date December 2, 2025
⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️ ⭐️

When I tell you this book gripped me from page one - I mean it. All Eyes on Him by Iliana Xander is the kind of thriller that doesn’t let up for a single second.

⚡ Fast-paced? Absolutely.
🌀 Repetitive? Not even a little.
💋 Characters? Likable, layered, and so easy to root for (even when they’re in way over their heads).

Natalie’s determination to uncover the truth had me holding my breath more than once. Between the high-gloss setting, the dark secrets, and that simmering “is he or isn’t he?” tension; this one scratched the thriller itch. 👀

If you love morally gray men, bold heroines, and cat-and-mouse stories where no one is safe… add this to your list immediately. 🖤
